_comment_file: Annotated hooks.json skeleton. Keys prefixed with _comment document the event and are NOT part of the schema; strip before shipping: jq 'walk(if type=="object" then with_entries(select(.key|startswith("_comment")|not)) else . end)' hooks.json. All 10 events shown; delete the ones you don't use.

PreToolUse._comment: Before tool call. Exit 2 BLOCKS; stderr is shown to Claude as the reason.

PostToolUse._comment: After tool call. Fires concurrently for parallel calls; script MUST be idempotent.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Before Claude sees the prompt. stdout is APPENDED to the prompt — stdout is a security surface. Exit 2 rejects the prompt.

Stop._comment: When Claude finishes a turn. In sub-agent frontmatter, auto-converted to SubagentStop.

Notification._comment: When Claude Code surfaces a notification. Use for custom alerting.

SessionStart._comment: Once at session start. Bootstrap per-session state; mirror in SessionEnd.

SessionEnd._comment: Once at session end. Cleanup mirror of SessionStart.

PreCompact._comment: Before auto-compaction summarizes the conversation. Snapshot state worth preserving.

SubagentStart._comment: Matcher is the sub-agent name. Per-agent setup.

SubagentStop._comment: Matcher is the sub-agent name. Mirror of SubagentStart.
